I be old man now, 63 years, and I done farm this yam and cassava plot for many years. The land na my own, so I take care of am well, but money no plenty for fertilizer — I go buy small NPK if subsidy reach me, and I go put the goat and chicken manure wey I gather for compound. I no get borehole for irrigate, so I depend on the rain wey come April to October. My sons and wife go help me, but for ridging and harvest time I must hire small labor because my back no strong like before.
